blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO — Victor Wembanyama had 50 points, with 32 coming in the first half, along with 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to a 114-91 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Saturday. Wembanyama is the first player with 30 points, 10 rebounds, three blocks and three steals in a game this season and he did so by halftime. Stephon Castle added 19 points, six assists and three rebounds for San Antonio, which has won 14 of 15 to join the Los Angeles Lakers atop the Western Conference at 14-3. READ: NBA: Wembanyama […]...
